title: FENEK's Artifacts
description: Adds unique and powerful artifacts to Minecraft, including the reverse ender pearl, multi-use enchanted golden books, and more!
body:
**FENEK's Artifacts** is a mod that adds unique magical items and enchantments with mechanics you won't find anywhere else. Each artifact is designed to offer new gameplay strategies - from pulling structures towards you to controlling mobs with EMP waves.

**🌀 Artifacts**

**Lraep Redne** - A cursed ender pearl that pulls blocks and entities towards you. Keeps NBT data (chests, spawners, etc.). Drops from Endermen (2%-5%).

**Enchanted Golden Book** - A reusable enchanted book with 3 charges. Transfer and merge enchantments without losing the item.

**Rune of Restoration** - Automatically repairs your equipment when it's about to break. Plays a totem sound with redstone particles. Found in End cities (2%) and stronghold libraries (1%).

**Tracker of Souls** - Binds to any entity and tracks its location. Right-click to bind, then use to reveal a particle trail toward the target. Works across dimensions.

**Destructive Parasite** - A dangerous artifact that devours dropped items within a 3-block radius. Each item consumed grants a random buff. When no items are left, it drains your food. If hunger reaches zero — it damages you.

**⚡ Enchantments**

**Excavation** - Mine up to 4 blocks in a straight line per swing. Max level III (1-3 extra blocks). Works on pickaxes and shovels. Incompatible with Silk Touch and Fortune.

**Catapulting** - Launches you high into the air when your elytra breaks mid-flight. Gives Slow Falling (8 sec). Elytra are destroyed after activation. Incompatible with Unbreaking.

**Lightning Rod** - Charge your shield by blocking attacks. Release devastating EMP waves to stun enemies and disable their AI.

**🌀 Effects**

**Electric Disorientation** - Inflicted by Lightning Rod's EMP. Freezes mobs in place (AI disabled), blocks players from attacking, and slightly reduces movement speed.
